VLAN-40-VAULT.purpose: Vault Core Server, Auth/NAC Engine, SIEM & Encrypted DB

VLAN-99-QUARANTINE.purpose: Non-Compliant / Blocked Devices Isolated by NAC/IPS

firewall_rules.name: Enforce TLS 1.3 Tunnel Ingress
firewall_rules.description: Allow only mutually authenticated TLS 1.3 / AES-256-GCM VPN tunnel traffic to Vault port 8443.

firewall_rules.name: Block Cleartext Legacy Protocols
firewall_rules.description: Deny unencrypted FTP (21), Telnet (23), and plaintext HTTP (80) across all internal VLANs.

firewall_rules.name: Mandatory NAC Device Admission
firewall_rules.description: Require valid NAC device registration, MAC match, and posture score >= 80 before admitting tunnel sessions.

firewall_rules.name: Isolate Quarantine VLAN
firewall_rules.description: Block all lateral movement from quarantined hosts to production or administrative subnets.

firewall_rules.name: Enforce RBAC Least Privilege
firewall_rules.description: Restrict every Vault and administrative command strictly to roles authorized in rbac_policy.json.

firewall_rules.name: Restrict Management Plane Access
firewall_rules.description: Allow policy updates, IPS unban, and backup/restore commands exclusively from admin roles.

firewall_rules.name: Rate-Limit Flood / DDoS Protection
firewall_rules.description: Automatically quarantine any source exceeding 25 requests per 10 seconds to mitigate DoS/DDoS floods.

firewall_rules.name: Brute-Force Authentication Lockout
firewall_rules.description: Trigger active IPS ban after 4 failed authentication attempts within 60 seconds.

firewall_rules.name: Deep Payload Injection Blocking
firewall_rules.description: Drop packets and ban sources containing SQL injection, command injection, path traversal, or shellcode patterns.

firewall_rules.name: Cryptographic Integrity & Replay Defense
firewall_rules.description: Verify AES-256-GCM authentication tags and monotonic sequence numbers on every tunnel frame to stop MITM/replay.

firewall_rules.name: Local-Only AI Auditing Binding
firewall_rules.description: Keep AI threat auditing strictly bound to local Ollama (127.0.0.1:11434) so sensitive SIEM logs never leave the host.

firewall_rules.name: Tamper-Evident SIEM Hash Chaining
firewall_rules.description: Log all authentication, NAC, firewall, IPS, and vault events with SHA-256 hash chaining for forensic accountability.

firewall_rules.name: Restrict Maximum Frame Size
firewall_rules.description: Drop frames exceeding 64 KB to prevent memory exhaustion and buffer abuse attacks.

firewall_rules.name: Encrypted Backup & Integrity Verification
firewall_rules.description: Encrypt all vault state and security policy backups with AES-256-GCM and verify SHA-256 checksums before restore.

firewall_rules.name: Default-Deny Implicit Drop
firewall_rules.description: Implicitly drop and log any network connection or command not explicitly permitted by preceding security rules.

firewall_rules.name: Port Scan & Reconnaissance Mitigation
firewall_rules.description: Detect rapid probing of unauthorized ports or services and trigger immediate IPS quarantine.
